reason_for_new_version: The learned local checker now performs source-licensed transport of three structural fragments and recomputes ten. The joint learned closure now consumes the two executed productions, installed successors, licensed reuse, future divergence and executed forgetting on one lineage.
run_gate: Record a stable repository commit and pass the v9 freeze checker before executing the single confirmatory command.
properties_common_to_all_adapters: same aligned and bypass candidate values
translation_rules: Each adapter declares exactly which shared fields it consumes.
No adapter receives a target certificate or the constitutive final verdict as an oracle.
Out-of-interface and not-certified are reported as such, never as impossibility.
The relational comparator receives the same current and future executions, not only their current output table.
The reference combination runs causal, mutation, future and pre-effect checks explicitly and accounts for their translation work.

literature_references.comparison: typed mutation and local proof transport
executed neural causal roles and interventions
source-licensed fragment reuse and full recheck
fixed authorization boundaries and effect production
relational current and future execution comparison

comparison_methods.relational_method: Compare the aligned and bypass executions on the shared current domain and the same nonempty future contract while retaining their produced occurrences.
comparison_methods.reference_combination: Run current-table, intervention, causal dependency, mutation admission, future-contract and pre-effect checks without calling the constitutive checker verdict.
comparison_methods.full_recheck: Recompute the complete target certificate independently of incremental fragments and compare acceptance and successor with the incremental checker.

joint_closure.future_rule: The aligned installed runtime supplies the nonempty discriminating continuation; the bypass is simulated purely and never installed.
joint_closure.forgetting_rule: Executed forgetting preserves every covered finite future while separately proving non-recoverability of historical origin.

output_policy.format: immutable six-line NDJSON plus a separate post-run JSON record containing its SHA-256
output_policy.selection: all six rows retained in emitted order
output_policy.missing_output: protocol failure, not a negative scientific result
output_policy.hash_timing: output hash recorded after the first permitted production

versioning_rule: Any change to shared material, adapters, translations, R1-R8, P1-P8, S1-S8, decision rules, commands or schema requires a later version before affected production.
